cases.primary_checks: Hit integrity and credit restore with asymmetric legal FEB frame cadence.

cases.primary_checks: Max-hit frame shape and hit preservation with deep ticket FIFO.

cases.scenario: Periodic egress stalls on the default native-SV datapath.
cases.primary_checks: Presenter hold/restart behavior and hit integrity under legal backpressure.

cases.scenario: Explicit always-ready baseline with the same native-SV harness plumbing.
cases.primary_checks: Healthy no-stall datapath baseline and zero-drop counter closure.

cases.scenario: Medium-duty ready profile with legal restart windows.
cases.primary_checks: Non-trivial healthy backpressure bins without entering the known overwrite probe path.

cases.scenario: Longer low-ready windows short of the forced-overwrite probe.
cases.primary_checks: Hold-under-backpressure and clean restart behavior without malformed egress.

cases.scenario: Default-build maximum-hit packet shape on the live symbol path.
cases.primary_checks: Max-hit frame shape and full hit preservation at the default build point.

cases.scenario: Single-cycle ready toggling at the egress interface.
cases.primary_checks: Short-toggle backpressure bins and presenter restart correctness.

cases.scenario: Burstier legal ready restart profile with shorter ready windows and deeper low stretches.
cases.primary_checks: Presenter hold/restart behavior across repeated medium-depth stall bursts.

cases.scenario: Short soak with repeated long FEB whole-frame traffic.
cases.primary_checks: Sustained hit integrity and credit restoration under repeated traffic bursts.

cases.scenario: Deterministic two-lane skew with repeated long frames.
cases.primary_checks: No missing or ghost hits under sustained lane skew.

cases.scenario: Whole-frame skew where activity alternates with legal empty frames.
cases.primary_checks: Packet-level cadence skew, zero drops, and monitor-side frame capture.

cases.scenario: Uneven per-lane frame-count stress on the active 2-lane harness contract.
cases.primary_checks: Sparse-frame residency, credit stability, and hit integrity without claiming 4-lane closure.

cases.scenario: Longer directed FEB whole-frame soak on the default 2-lane native-SV path.
cases.primary_checks: Sustained hit integrity and clean credit restore beyond the short promoted soak.

cases.scenario: Packet-boundary lane masking with multi-hit packets.
cases.primary_checks: Masked-drop accounting and zero unexpected egress output on the dropped lane.

cases.scenario: Minimal masked-drop packet on the active native-SV path.
cases.primary_checks: Single-hit drop accounting and CSR counter closure.

cases.scenario: Burst masked-drop traffic across several packets.
cases.primary_checks: Burst drop accounting and no-drop recovery on the still-enabled lane.

cases.scenario: Mask all active lanes, accumulate drops, then clear the mask and resume healthy traffic.
cases.primary_checks: Masked-header drop accounting plus verified clean recovery on the next legal FEB packets.

cases.scenario: Inject a malformed subheader, then follow with a legal recovery frame on both active lanes.
cases.primary_checks: Ingress subheader-error masking without poisoning the following legal packet.

cases.scenario: Runtime counter clear after drop-producing traffic.
cases.primary_checks: Visible CSR counter reset semantics and post-clear clean state.

cases.scenario: Reduced-depth overwrite pressure under hard egress stall on the native-SV presenter path.
cases.primary_checks: Frame-table drop counters increment, overwritten residents are suppressed, and no malformed accepted egress escapes under overwrite pressure.

cases.scenario: Backpressure crossed with credit restoration on FEB whole-frame traffic.
cases.primary_checks: Credit recovery, no ghost hits, and legal restart behavior under mixed-axis stress.

cases.scenario: Runtime DRR allowance programming with asymmetric lane service.
cases.primary_checks: CSR programming, defer counters, and directed service fairness.

cases.scenario: One hit-idle peer lane that still emits legal empty-frame cadence.
cases.primary_checks: DRR fairness with empty-frame cadence preserved on the idle lane.

cases.scenario: Zero-allowance lane starvation followed by reload and resumed service.
cases.primary_checks: Directed defer/reload behavior and zero-allowance fairness recovery.

cases.scenario: Short-quantum reload with repeated service handoff.
cases.primary_checks: Directed DRR reload and service-handoff behavior under constrained allowance.

cases.scenario: One hit-idle lane crossed with periodic egress stalls on the active lane.
cases.primary_checks: Idle-lane cadence preservation and clean restart behavior under backpressure.
cases.contract_anchor: DV_CROSS idle-lane cadence x backpressure closure.

cases.scenario: Random mixed-bucket soak that draws safe directed scenarios from BASIC, EDGE, PROF, ERROR, and CROSS.
cases.primary_checks: Multi-bucket chained hit integrity, bucket visitation, and no-restart drain stability under randomized sequencing.

coverage_hole_disposition.reason: Header-error and header-word recovery remain probe-only, so the MASK_PKT_EXTENDED re-entry and stale-context cleanup paths are still under-covered in promoted native-SV evidence.
coverage_hole_disposition.next_action: Fix parser recovery reinitialization, promote the clean recovery cases, and rerun merged coverage.

coverage_hole_disposition.reason: The remaining low FSM-transition coverage lines up with the still-open bursty DRR random probe plus the lack of signed-off 4-lane DV and Arria 10 synthesis evidence.
coverage_hole_disposition.evidence_anchor: BUG-009-R; opq_cross_drr_bursty_random_test; opq_prof_missing_empty_frame_test @ OPQ_N_LANE=4; doc/SIGNOFF.md standalone_syn
coverage_hole_disposition.next_action: Refresh the bursty DRR random evidence and record real 4-lane DV plus A10 standalone closure before expanding the signoff claim.

coverage_hole_disposition.reason: The reduced-depth overwrite repro is now green in isolation, but the promoted suite still lacks a directed hybrid that couples flush pressure with legal backpressure windows over a default-build runtime.
coverage_hole_disposition.next_action: Add the directed backpressure-plus-flush hybrid testcase and use it to raise presenter transition and toggle coverage.

coverage_hole_disposition.reason: A large part of the wrapper hole count comes from fixed-scope native-SV configuration, dormant CSR decode/default branches, and status/meta observability that are outside the active 2-lane signoff claim.
coverage_hole_disposition.evidence_anchor: ordered_priority_queue_dut_sv.sv:227-245, 268-337, 494-505; DV_REPORT non-claims for OPQ_N_LANE=2 and reduced-depth isolated points
coverage_hole_disposition.next_action: Keep the wrapper holes documented as non-claims unless a dedicated CSR decode sweep becomes a signoff requirement.

coverage_hole_disposition.reason: The lowest remaining toggle bins are wide storage-array data bits. Extra fill-pattern tests would mostly churn memory bit coverage without closing a new architectural contract.
coverage_hole_disposition.evidence_anchor: ticket_fifo / lane_fifo / handle_fifo / page_ram toggle summaries in the merged native-SV UCDB
coverage_hole_disposition.next_action: Do not promote memory-bit churn tests for signoff; only revisit if a real storage-corruption bug appears.
